DropItem.title: DropItem
DropItem.description: A single text snippet, link, image, or file dropped into the user's personal cross-device feed.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the owner who created this drop.

content.description: Text payload, URL, or file description/caption (UTF-8, Thai supported).

fileName.description: Original UTF-8 filename for uploaded images or files.

fileSize.description: Size of uploaded file in bytes (0 to 10 MB).

mimeType.description: MIME type of the uploaded file or image.

chunkCount.description: Number of Bytes chunk docs under drops/{dropId}/chunks.

previewDataUrl.description: Inline JPEG thumbnail data URL for images.

isCode.description: Whether text content should render in monospace code presentation.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp set at creation via serverTimestamp().

DropChunk.title: DropChunk
DropChunk.description: Raw file bytes slice (≤ 768 KiB) for a cloud file drop.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the owner.

index.description: Zero-based chunk position; equals the document ID.

/drops/{dropId}.description: Private per-user drops collection storing text snippets, links, and file/image metadata (Firestore-only, no Cloud Storage).

/drops/{dropId}/chunks/{chunkId}.description: Owner-scoped immutable Bytes chunks holding file content.
